title: Model delegated and supported agency as a governed relationship
requirements:
- Distinguish a relationship record from current authority to act
- Recognise that people may act through supporters or authorised representatives
- Include proxies, guardians and caregivers in the minimum actor set
- State that the architecture should be able to represent and enforce delegation, with legal rules left to national law
- Add delegated and supported access to the LHR requirements

history.what: reopened: its comments were reopened (PC-0035, PC-0036, PC-0051); nothing in it has been decided
